name: live-capturer
description: Structures what a workshop room produces, during breaks and right after the session, part of the Workshop Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run live-capturer", "here are the photos of the walls", "capture this session", pastes workshop notes, wall photos, board exports, or transcript fragments, or says "the workshop just ended, help me not lose this". Use it even for a single photo of a post-it wall.
